La Pyndonkam bakla ha ka Politik ia ki 
kyntien Khasi ban pynthame paidbah 

Mawphor 19-8-1992 

Ua ka politik ki raiigbah kiba don ha ki 
parti Jylla kum ka HPU, HSPDP, PDIC ne 
kum ka APHLC bad ka EITU ha ki por ba 
la leit bad ki parti India kum ka Kongres, 
Komunis bad mynia ka Janata Dal bad BJP, 
ki pyndonkam katba mon ia ki kyntien Khasi 
ne “Ktien Khasi” kaiba mon tang ban iohnong 
bad jop elekshon. Ki batai da kuinwei ha ki 
para Ri ha u Hynnie\Mrep bad da ki mwci pat 
ha ki nongwd. ha kum ki Koch. Rabha. JVlikir, 
Garo, Bengali, u Hindustani bad kiwei kiwei 
haba ki hap ban balai da ka ktien Phareng. 
Ki kyntien Khasi ba kham pyndonkam bakla 
eh ki long kum kine: para Riewlum, parti Riew- 
lum. Parti Dkhar, Jylla Ba-Pura, State Ba- Pura, 
Khasi-Pnar bad kumta ter ter. Yn iapyrshang 
ban iatai khyndiat khamtam namar ba mynta

ba la jan ka ialap elekshon da kine ki parti- 
Trai Ri, Parti Jylla bad Parti National ne 
Parti India. 

1. Ka Jylla Ba Pura — Ka Meghalaya: Mynta 
baroh ha Ri India, lait sa tang kum ka Pondi- 
chcry kaba daag dn'i lang ka Union Territory, 
ki dei ki Jyliu ba pura kat kum ka Konstitution 
ka India. Ngi dang hap hapoh Assam ruh 
ngi don hi Iia ka lyPa kaba pura. Mynta ha- 
poh ka Meghalaya, kaba ngi khot ka Hills 
Stale, ngi don hi ha ka Jylla kaba pura. 

Ki Naga, ki Mizo ruh ki don ha ka Jylla 
Nagaland bad Mizoram ba pura, ki Jylla ba 
pura hi kumjuh kum ka Meghalaya. Na ka 
liang ka jaiibynricw u Khun Khasi Khara, 
uba don hapoh kine ki District, Ri Bhoi, 
Jaintia Hills, East bad West Khasi Hills ha ka 
Bri U Hynniewtrep ki don hok ba kin ong 
ngi cion ha ka Jylla kaba Pura. Kumjuh u 
Garo, u Hajong, u Rabha, u Mikir bad kiwei 
kiwei ki dkhar ruh kiba long trai shnong ka 
Meghalaya ki lah ban kam kumjuh ba ki don

Na u Mynder ka don ka jingma ia ngi 
u Hynniewtrep bad iaka Bri U Hynniewtrep 
bad kumjuh ruh ia ka Ri India baroh kawei. 
Na kanc ka Hang u paidbah udei ban iarap 
ia ka sorkar bad ka sorkar India lyniba ki a in 
ba kyrpang bad ka Konstilushon bad ka jing- 
buh shipai ha ki khappud kala leh la ka karri.

Na kane ka liang lehse ympat juh don ka 
jingiakhih paidbah. Shisha la ia pyndonkam 
bakla iaka ktien mynder bad ia shoh kat uba 
lap u dkhur na kawei ka por sha kawei ka por 
ha ka jingbyrngein da kum kinc ki kyntien ba 
ki thoh ha ki kvnroh kumne : “Beh Mynder”. 
U Mynder u dei ii briew uba na sha bar ka Ri 
India ne u Foreigner kumba ong ha ka ktien 
phareng. Haei ju ialap uta u Khar Bangh’desh 
ne u Khar Pakistan ba don dukan khlem lisen 
ha iewduh ? Kine baroh ki dukan nongwei 
ne dukan dkhar hapoh Shillong bad ha Iewduh 
ki dei hi ki para ri nong India, tangba ki 
dci na sha bar ka Bri u Hynniewtrep ne ka 
Home Land Jong u, ki ain ban iada ia ka 
khyndew ban num poi lut sha kine ki bar 
jylia ki don ba la thaw hi da ka sorkar 
jylia bad da ka Konstilushon. Hynrei ka jingeh 
ka long ba imat la pyndonkam bakla ne 
bymmon ban pyntreikam ia kine ki ain baroh
